definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.description: Determine whether one complete static plan can satisfy every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted scenario. Compare feasible plans only after whole-plan execution feasibility is established.

authoring.guidance:
What must be completed, for whom, and within which accepted limits?
Which objects, quantities, revisions and locations are covered?
Which factual records and admitted states are we relying on?
Which complete choices may the planner make?
Which activities, dependencies, calendars and capacities must the same plan respect?
Which scoped permissions must cover each required operation?
Which joint operating scenarios must this commitment withstand?
Which obligations are mandatory, and how will passing complete plans be compared?
Module authors supply these declarations and domain vocabulary. Case workers supply only values allowed by the frozen module. Facts, scenarios and operating permission must never be inferred from a preferred plan.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

caseDerivation: All case parameters and keyed input rows use the frozen module.inputs types, units, bounds, keys and references; no missing-value defaults or coercion are inferred.
Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.
schema.description: Installed closed typed declaration and case-admission validators; this descriptor is not a complete JSON Schema. Publication checks admission, not computed feasibility.

structuralSlots.description: Declare one time origin, common time and money units, and additional numeric units.
Declare required typed parameters and keyed relations.
Declare finite static controls from input-only domains.
Bind the input relation containing explicit joint scenarios.
Bind typed acyclic consequences using the installed expression language.
Declare static activity actors, timing and renewable resource demands.
Map resource capacities and existing bookings.
Name and explain every mandatory commitment obligation.
Bind predicates and shared resource-capacity checks to obligations.
Declare nonrefundable charges and optional timed refundable holds.
Optionally require complete finite lookup coverage.
Supply domain vocabulary without changing calculations.
State accepted premises and the applicability boundary.

caseInputs.description: Supply every declared parameter, including finite choice grids and current limits.
Supply typed records, accepted scenarios, calendars, grants, resources and other declared facts.
Record the accepted source and scope of supplied information.

responsibilities: Complete candidate assignments and all checked scenarios
Activities, interval/resource checks and scoped permission traces
Expense, timed cash events and peak cash where declared

# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: complete-a-commitment/1
module:
  id: marble-bag-delivery
  title: Plan marble delivery
  description: "Can one complete plan deliver the whole bag containing the heavy marble, sealed and accompanied by its identifying record, within the accepted receipt and prepaid expense limits?"
  question: "Can we complete the whole-bag delivery?"
  template:
    id: complete-a-commitment
    version: 1
  units:
    time: synthetic tick
    money: hypothetical dollar
    count: unit of resource capacity
    timeOrigin: tick 0 of the accepted operating snapshot
  assumptions: ["This draft is a static, finite planning model. Every activity in a complete plan must be performed; task assignments cannot branch on a future observation.", "Packing means packing and sealing one selected whole bag. Record preparation produces the identifying record that accompanies that same bag; no further work is required in this stipulated fixture.", All modeled intervals use the common OPS-1 clock and are half-open. Adjacent intervals may share a boundary without overlapping., "The nine listed marble memberships and masses remain stable. Transporting a sealed bag preserves its contents. Receipt occurs at modeled arrival; no loss, damage or unlisted work is modeled.", "The accepted E3 evidence review supplies factual alternatives, not controllable choices. All six listed heavy-identity and travel-condition combinations are admitted; their rows assert no probabilities.", "Every listed worker has capacity one. Packing additionally uses the single bench; preparing the record uses the separate single desk. The bench reservation is fixed.", The packing-grant registry is complete within this fixture. An absent matching full-interval grant means no usable packing permission. Record preparation requires its declared capability and no separate grant., "Service durations are deterministic conditional on the listed travel condition. Each modeled task fee and service fee is prepaid. No borrowing, separate refundable hold or time-indexed cash constraint is modeled.", The timing grids and listed entities bound the candidate domain.     - id: SUFFICIENCY
      label: Correct whole bag
      meaning: "Deliver the selected whole bag, which contains the heavy marble under each admitted factual state. Packing seals it; its completed identifying record accompanies it."
      waivable: false
    - id: RESOURCES
      label: Workers and workspaces
      meaning: "Each assigned worker has the required capability and full task availability. Combined worker, bench and desk demands respect capacity and fixed bookings."
      waivable: false
    - id: TIME
      label: Ready and received in time
      meaning: "Packing and record preparation both finish before dispatch; receipt occurs by the accepted deadline in every admitted travel condition."
      waivable: false
    - id: AUTHORITY
      label: Packing permission
      meaning: "A grant for the same worker, selected bag and pack action covers the entire packing interval in the stipulated complete registry."
      waivable: false
    - id: ACCESS
      label: Dispatch and receipt access
      meaning: "The chosen service offers the selected dispatch time and arrival is within the recipient’s half-open access window."
      waivable: false

      meaning: Both task fees and the service fee together stay within the accepted prepaid expense limit.
      waivable: false

      kind: predicate
      predicate:

        table: marbles

            ref: choice.bag
          inventory:

    - id: bag-in-scope

      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: bags
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.bag
          inventory:
            ref: parameter.inventory
    - id: pack-capability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: workerCapabilities
        where:

            ref: choice.packWorker
          action:
            literal: pack
    - id: record-capability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: workerCapabilities
        where:
          worker:
            ref: choice.recordWorker
          action:
            literal: record
    - id: pack-availability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: workerAvailability
        where:
          worker:
            ref: activity.pack.actor
        start:
          ref: activity.pack.start
        end:
          ref: activity.pack.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: record-availability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: workerAvailability
        where:
          worker:
            ref: activity.record.actor
        start:
          ref: activity.record.start
        end:
          ref: activity.record.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: combined-resource-capacity
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: resource-capacity
    - id: pack-before-dispatch
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: activity.pack.end
          - ref: choice.departure
    - id: record-before-dispatch
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: activity.record.end
          - ref: choice.departure
    - id: receipt-by-deadline
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: derived.arrival
          - ref: parameter.deadline
    - id: scoped-packing-grant
      requirement: AUTHORITY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: grants
        where:
          actor:
            ref: choice.packWorker
          bag:
            ref: choice.bag
          action:
            literal: pack
        test:
          op: and
          args:
            - op: lte
              args:
                - ref: row.start
                - ref: activity.pack.start
            - op: gte
              args:
                - ref: row.end
                - ref: activity.pack.end
    - id: offered-dispatch
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: serviceDepartures
        where:
          service:
            ref: choice.service
          time:
            ref: choice.departure
    - id: receipt-window
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: lte
            args:
              - ref: parameter.receiptOpen
              - ref: derived.arrival
          - op: lt
            args:
              - ref: derived.arrival
              - ref: parameter.receiptClose
    - id: prepaid-expense-limit
      requirement: COST
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: finance.expense
          - ref: parameter.expenseLimit
  finance:
    mode: expense
    charges:
      - id: packing-fee
        amount:
          op: lookup
          table: workers
          where:
            id:

          column: fee
      - id: record-fee

          table: workers

      - id: delivery-fee

    then:

module.title: Plan marble delivery
module.description: Can one complete plan deliver the whole bag containing the heavy marble, sealed and accompanied by its identifying record, within the accepted receipt and prepaid expense limits?
module.question: Can we complete the whole-bag delivery?

units.timeOrigin: tick 0 of the accepted operating snapshot

assumptions: This draft is a static, finite planning model. Every activity in a complete plan must be performed; task assignments cannot branch on a future observation.
Packing means packing and sealing one selected whole bag. Record preparation produces the identifying record that accompanies that same bag; no further work is required in this stipulated fixture.
All modeled intervals use the common OPS-1 clock and are half-open. Adjacent intervals may share a boundary without overlapping.
The nine listed marble memberships and masses remain stable. Transporting a sealed bag preserves its contents. Receipt occurs at modeled arrival; no loss, damage or unlisted work is modeled.

The accepted E3 evidence review supplies factual alternatives, not controllable choices. All six listed heavy-identity and travel-condition combinations are admitted; their rows assert no probabilities.
Every listed worker has capacity one. Packing additionally uses the single bench; preparing the record uses the separate single desk. The bench reservation is fixed.

The packing-grant registry is complete within this fixture. An absent matching full-interval grant means no usable packing permission. Record preparation requires its declared capability and no separate grant.

Service durations are deterministic conditional on the listed travel condition. Each modeled task fee and service fee is prepaid. No borrowing, separate refundable hold or time-indexed cash constraint is modeled.
The timing grids and listed entities bound the candidate domain. Passing this calculation neither grants authority nor books workers or transport.
